LanguageData.RK_Hediff_LanceChargeFocus.label: Combat focus
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_LanceChargeFocus.description: Temporary increase in combat effectiveness after charging. This increases their ability to hit targets at the cost of reduced chance to dodge.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_LanceChargeExhaustion.label: Charge Exhaustion
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_LanceChargeExhaustion.descript: Generalized exhaustion of the body caused from charging recently. Given some time to rest, this will pass relatively quickly.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_LanceChargeMomentum.label: charge momentum
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_LanceChargeMomentum.descriptio: Damage is being increased by the speed of the charge. Also if you are seeing this, hi! This is normally hidden.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterCaster.label: Rallying cry
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterCaster.descriptio: This person is using a special ability to raise nearby allies' morale. Everyone within range gains a constant combat support bonus.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterBuffWeak.label: rallied
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterBuffWeak.descript: Weakly raised morale has improved this person's abilities.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterBuffDefault.label: rallied
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterBuffDefault.descr: Raised morale has improved this person's abilities.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterBuffStrong.label: rallied
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_MoraleBoosterBuffStrong.descri: Significantly raised morale has improved this person's abilities.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_FakeEar.label: prosthetic Ratkin ear
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_FakeEar.description: A prosthetic ratkin ear. It is made out of cloth and only partially restores hearing.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_BionicTail.label: bionic Ratkin tail
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_BionicTail.description: An installed bionic ratkin tail. It features an AI that monitors the users movement and moves the tail in response, allowing it to replicate the user's missing tail almost perfectly. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological tail in almost every way.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_FakeTail.label: prosthetic Ratkin tail
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_FakeTail.description: A prosthetic ratkin tail. It is less of a tail and more of a counterweight meant to imitate the corrective properties of a biological tail.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_Torn.label: tear
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_RatHolicGun.label: rotational inertia
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_RatHolicGunSpooling.label: spooling up
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_RatHolicGunSpooling.descriptio: The barrels are building up rotational speed, and the gun is gradually gaining fire rate.
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_RatHolicGunSpoolingAim.label: target lock
LanguageData.RK_Hediff_RatHolicGunSpoolingAim.descrip: Barrel inertia shortens the time needed to realign with the target.
